t: 蒙古人于克米尔尼克战役中将克克洛克沃的波兰军队压倒并掠夺了该城.
te: Mongols overwhelm Polish armies in Kraków in the Battle of Chmielnik and plunder the city.
dz: 蒙古人第一次入侵波兰:蒙古人于克米尔尼克战役中将克克洛克沃的波兰军队压倒并掠夺了该城.
de: First Mongol invasion of Poland: Mongols overwhelm Polish armies in Kraków in the Battle of Chmielnik and plunder the city.

t: 利格尼茨战役:蒙古军击败了波兰和德军.
te: Mongol forces defeat the Polish and German armies.
dz: 利格尼茨战役:蒙古军击败了波兰和德军.
de: Battle of Liegnitz: Mongol forces defeat the Polish and German armies.

t: 巴图汗在莫希战役中击败了匈牙利的贝拉四世.
te: Batu Khan defeats Béla IV of Hungary at the Battle of Mohi.
dz: 巴图汗在莫希战役中击败了匈牙利的贝拉四世.
de: Batu Khan defeats Béla IV of Hungary at the Battle of Mohi.
